items.title: Accelerating the migration of end-of-support applications
items.summary: Introduction Migrating your applications to the cloud is tough. In this blog post, we show you how Amazon Web Services (AWS) helps customers modernize applications even when the source code is no longer available. This is a common challenge with end-of-support, legacy, and third-party workloads. Traditional refactoring isn’t an option without source code, leaving these […]
